display.title: Hashem Is Everywhere: The Hidden Secrets of the Word Echad
display.summary_short: The three letters of Echad hide a lesson: Hashem is the Master of the world, Creator of the heavens and earth, and found in every direction. With the song 'Hashem Is Here, Hashem Is There'.
display.summary_long: A segment from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Hashem wrote the Torah and packed it with hidden secrets, and Uncle Yossi opens one of them: the word Echad from the Shema. Our Sages in the Gemara explain its three letters. Aleph, the first letter, stands for Hashem, who was here before anything was created, and it also means 'master', for Hashem runs the whole world. Ches is the number eight: the seven heavens and the one earth that Hashem created. Daled is four, the four directions of north, south, east and west. That is why we cover our eyes when we say the Shema and think that Hashem is everywhere, watching over us, protecting us and keeping us alive every second. The clip ends with everyone singing 'Hashem is here, Hashem is there, Hashem is truly everywhere'.
display.lesson: When we say 'Echad' in the Shema, we remember that Hashem is everywhere, above, below and in every direction.

sources_cited.note: The Aleph, Ches and Daled of 'Echad'; cited as 'the Gemara Brachos'.
